own_solution.law: R' = k^2 R0 = 18 ohm at constant volume; P = V^2 / R'
assumptions: uniform drawing, constant resistivity and temperature

defect_reasons.other: T4B85 'Before the power was measured, ... was connected' relies on the reader inferring the cell is still in place during the measurement; the intended R reading is the natural one but the wording is slightly less explicit than TC461.

notes: Checked certified answers: (12+3.5)^2/18 = 240.25/18 = 13.347 W; 19.5^2/18 = 21.125 W; 28^2/18 = 43.556 W; base 144/18 = 8 W. C cancellation of L0 is correct (R' = k^2 R0 independent of L0). Minimal pairs TDA6F/TC461 and TF0E0/T4B85 share 7.5 V and differ only in attachment. TE42B and T4F86 are numeral-free twins by design, which resolves my pass-1 remark about their missing value. Agree with all strata.
